name: Guo Tai Epoint Software Co.,Ltd
summary: Guo Tai Epoint Software Co.,Ltd offers software and information technology solutions in China. The company operates through Smart Procurement, Smart Government Affairs, and Digital Construction segments. It provides one-stop online service, big data, office collaboration, and unified city governance; E-government procurement, corporate procurement, and smart bidding tools; digital housing and development, digital construction, and digital cost estimation solutions. The company also provides scientific research and technical services. Guo Tai Epoint Software Co.,Ltd was founded in 1998 and is based in Zhangjiagang, China.
